facts.fact: CIPIT says Ethiopia enacted the Personal Data Protection Proclamation No. 1321/2024, a general law setting data subject rights and controller and processor duties; no commencement date is given.

CIPIT says the Proclamation establishes the Ethiopian Communications Authority as the independent supervisory authority, with which controllers and processors must register; no appointment of its head or members is stated.
CIPIT says Ethiopia's Digital Identification Proclamation No. 1284/2023 established the Fayda programme, which issues registrants a unique 12-digit number.

CIPIT says Proclamation No. 1284/2023 sets up a digital identity regime issuing a unique 12-digit Fayda number, with registration using biometrics (facial photograph, iris, fingerprints) per the Fayda portal.

ETH.note: The only localisation rule stated binds personal data in general, not government data.
Only targets (90 million by 2026; 32 million in Addis Ababa over five years); no count enrolled.
Nothing on a number at birth; the ID is issued from age 5.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
Nothing on public registers keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: CIPIT says Ethiopia's Fayda programme issues registrants a unique 12-digit number, and as of October 2024 the National ID Program had opened more than 160 registration centres in Addis Ababa.
